Range: ER 1,305 nmi, below the 1,500 nmi anchor -> 0.0 (LR 1,650 nmi would be 0.0 too). Capacity: 50 seats -> under 60 -> 0.0. Efficiency: no fuel burn figure -> null. Speed: normal cruise Mach 0.74 -> 1 + (0.74-0.70)/(0.78-0.70) = 1.5. Runway: 5,800 ft (ER) at MTOW, SL, ISA -> 5 - 300/1,500 = 4.8 -> 5.0 (LR 6,290 ft would be 4.5). Operator/period-specific scratched-window and ageing-but-comfortable comments do not establish a universal launch-era cabin score. Three CRJ200 sibling reviews removed; one more independent exact CRJ100 report needed.
